name: Backer
tagline: Back up your photos and videos to a NAS you own.
description: Backer copies your photo and video folders from a Mac or PC to a network drive at home (a NAS, such as a Synology), on a schedule or when you ask. It never deletes anything on the drive without asking.

name: CeeVee
tagline: Run your whole job search from your own computer.
description: CeeVee keeps your resume, the jobs you are tracking and your applications on your computer. Its built-in AI model drafts a tailored resume and cover letter for each job, fills in application forms and stops for you to check them, and links replies from employers to the right application.

name: Golden
tagline: See when your household can retire, from your own statements.
description: Golden imports the statement files your bank and card companies provide, keeps your household's books, and runs a retirement plan that shows when you can retire and what would move the date. Your statements and plan stay on your computer, in an encrypted database.
plans_title: Plans with automatic bank updates (coming soon)
plans_note: Everything in Golden. Automatic bank and card updates through Plaid aren't available yet. They will be added to these plans when they are ready. Until then, you import statements the same way as with the one-time license.
